summary: Enhanced Ctrl+Tab cycles recent places, with observed Control-release commit, explicit-popup fallback, and live activity and attention labels.

compatibility.detail: Enhanced Ctrl+Tab cycles recent places; modifier-release commit activates only after real Control release events are observed, otherwise Enter commits. Typing switches to explicit commit. Attached Ctrl+^ and Ctrl+Tab remain program input. Tabs retain quiet brackets and Ctrl+PageUp/PageDown.
